title: Getting Dressed
description: Three short recordings about clothes: a cold morning, a rainy day and school clothes.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · A cold morning
parts.intro: You will hear Nam and his mum.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Nam, it's time to get dressed. It's cold today.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: I want my blue T-shirt, Mum.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: No, wear your red jumper. It's very cold.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: OK. Are my socks on the chair?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: No, they are under the bed. They are white.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Found them! Now I need my shoes.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Hurry, Nam. Breakfast is ready. We have eggs and toast.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Yummy! I'm hungry, Mum. I'm coming now.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Good boy. Brush your teeth after breakfast.

parts.title: Part 2 · A rainy day
parts.intro: You will hear Linh and her brother Tom.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Tom, look! It's raining.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Oh no. I want to wear my shorts.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: No, Tom. Put on your long trousers and your yellow coat.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Can I wear my hat?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Yes, wear your green hat. It's a nice hat.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Thank you, Linh. I have my coat and my hat now.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Great! Take your umbrella too. Let's go to school.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: OK, I'm ready. I like the rain a little.

parts.title: Part 3 · My school clothes
parts.intro: You will hear a girl called Mai.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Hello! My name is Mai. I go to school every day.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I wear a white shirt and a blue skirt.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I have new shoes. They are black. I love my new shoes.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I don't like my hat. It is too big.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I put on my clothes in the morning. Then I eat breakfast.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: My mum helps me. She is kind. I like my school very much.

questions.explanation: Mum says: "wear your red jumper." Blue is the T-shirt.
Mum says the socks are under the bed.
No. Mum says it is cold.

questions.explanation: Tom says: "I want to wear my shorts."

questions.explanation: Yes. She says she loves them.
